description: Explains Bhāskara II’s twelfth-century Indian mathematical astronomy through the Līlāvatī and Bījagaṇita, signed arithmetic, the cyclic method for indeterminate equations, trigonometry and astronomical computation. Distinguishes documented teaching traditions from the later wedding legend and from retrospective claims about calculus.
